<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>כמימר שֵׁיזְבֵנִי</he> as if saying, save me.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 20:6">Targ. Is. XX, 6</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ned. IV, 38ᵈ <he>וא׳ כולה</he> and all (the neighborhood) was saved (spared from conflagration); Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>תִּשְׁתֵּיזֵיב מן צנתא</he> mayest thou be saved from cold.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:1">Koh. R. to XI, 1</cite> <he>ולא א׳ גכאי מידי</he> and nothing has been left me (from the shipwreck).
